result.final:
Rewrote the wchunk container implementation to match the authoritative samples in assets/ rather than the superseded docs/FORMAT.md draft.

Derived layout (verified by hand-computing zlib.crc32(b"WCHK\x02" + b"\x00"*7) == 0xEF13D7F1, matching sample_empty.wchk bytes 12..16 little-endian):
- header.py: 12-byte header = b"WCHK" + version u8 (2) + record count u32 LITTLE-endian (draft wrongly said big-endian) + 3 reserved zero bytes. Added check_magic/check_version so error priority is magic > version > truncated > structure.
- codec.py: record = tag u16 LE + size u16 LE + payload + zero padding to roundup8(4 + size). Trailer = 6 bytes: CRC-32 u32 LE over header + entire record area (incl. padding), then sum of all tags u16 LE (sample tags 1+2+300+4+65000 = 65307 = 0x FF1B -> bytes "1b ff"; empty sample -> "00 00"). Replaced the varint/no-padding/4-byte-trailer scheme that caused both the wrong container length and phantom (0, b"") records parsed out of padding.
- crc.py: compute_crc is n
